senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; contr. of עדת , v. עוּד; or of ענת, v. עוֹנָה I) [duration, turn,]

units: <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 1:1">Tosef. Ber. I, 1</cite>; a. e., v. <cite ref="P00297"><he>עוֹנָה</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 109a:2">Pes. 109ᵃ</cite>; <he>מימיו לא אמר הגיע עת לעמוד וכ׳</he> never in his life did he (R. ʿAḳiba) say, it is time to rise from (leave) the house of study, except &c.; <cite ref="Sukkah 28a:4">Succ. 28ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 8a:1">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 69:14">Ps. LXIX, 14</cite>) <he>אימתי עת רצון בשעה וכ׳</he> when is the time of favor? When the congregation is at prayer.
<cite ref="Taanit 24b:6">Taan. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>שמע מינה עת רצון היא</he> I learn from this (dream) that this is an auspicious time for prayer.
Yeb. 72ᵃ עת רצון מילתא היא there is something in the idea of a time of favor for prayer; a. fr.—מֵעֵת לָעֵת (abbrev. מעל״ע) the time of twenty-four astronomical hours.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 1:1">Nidd. I, 1</cite> <he>מעל״ע ממעטת עליד מפקידה לפקידה וכ׳</he> the term of twenty-four hours (of retrospective uncleanness) reduces the term of the interval from one examination to the other &c., i.e. we go by the shorter term whichever it may be.

<cite ref="Chullin 51b">Ḥull. 51ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Zevachim 74b:12">Zeb. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>צריכה מעל״ע</he> requires the intervening of twenty-four hours (before it may be slaughtered); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P00711"><he>עִתִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00711"><he>עִתּוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00072"><he>עִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 28a:16">R. Hash. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ חלים ע׳ שוטה</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 1:3">Tosef. Ter. I, 3</cite> <he>פעמים</he>), v. <cite ref="H01081"><he>חָלַם</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:2">Tam. I, 2</cite> <he>לא כל הע׳ שוות</he> the time (for the appearance of the superintendent) was not always the same.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:18">Y. Ber. IX, end, 14ᵈ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 119:126">Ps. CXIX, 126</cite>) <he>העושה תורתו ע׳ … מיפר ברית</he> he who makes the study of the Law a matter of time, destroys the covenant.

Sabb. 31ᵃ בשעה … נשאת ונתת באמונה קבעת ע׳ לתורה when man is brought up for judgment, he is asked, hast thou been dealing with integrity? hast thou had regular times for the study of the Law? Snh. 65ᵇ ע׳ ושעות, v. עוּן; a. e.—לְעִיתּוֹתֵי עֶרֶב at the evening appointments (when labor is stopped, the work reviewed, wages paid &c.), in gen. towards evening.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:10">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:10">VIII</cite>), 10; Bab. Ber. 65ᵃ. Y. Ber. II, 5ᶜ top. Y. Succ. IV, beg. 54ᵇ. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ top <he>לציצותי</he>, Var. <he>לציתותי</he> (read: <he>לציתותי ערב</he>); a. e.
